name: flow_link_back_keeps_the_party
description: The session's link to the server goes during a party match and the server answers again 3 s later: the game keeps its world (reconnecting, orders waiting), and its MatchClient opens a new link with a resume HELLO, the same identity token and the seat it held. The server takes it back to its party (PARTY_STATE: still two members, me among them), MATCH_CONFIG(rejoin) and RESYNC(rejoin); it catches up and plays on, still in the match, never on the results. When the match ends, Play again brings it back to the same party on the connection the reconnect opened.

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'IN_MATCH' and node('ConnectionOverlay').state == 1 and not Game.accepts_commands()
steps.msg: the link is gone: the world stays, reconnecting, orders waiting
it holds match 1 and its wire seat for the resume HELLO

steps.assert: Session.get_node('LoopbackHub').seq.rejoins == 1 and Session.client.resumes >= 1 and Session.client.token == token and Session.client.resyncs[0][0] == 'rejoin'
steps.msg: a resume HELLO with the same identity token took the seat back: RESYNC(rejoin)

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'IN_MATCH' and Session.party_size() == 2 and Session.party_code() == 'K7Q4M' and Session.is_leader()
steps.msg: the server's PARTY_STATE kept me in my party, as its leader

steps.wait_until: not Session.client.catching_up and not Session.client.reconnecting and Game.accepts_commands()

steps.assert: node('ConnectionOverlay').state == 0 and node('ResultsPanel') == null and Session.client.phase_name() == 'IN_MATCH'
steps.msg: caught up: the overlay is gone, the match plays on, no results
the match ended on its own results

steps.assert: Session.state_name() == 'HUB' and Session.client.link == link_after and Session.client.phase_name() == 'WAITING' and Session.client.link.is_open()
steps.msg: back in the hub on the connection the reconnect opened

steps.assert: Session.party_code() == 'K7Q4M' and node('PartyCount').text == '2/4' and node('HubPanel').lines()[1] == 'circle Ana lookout'
